== Suppressed Messages ==

There are no valid display names found for the code urn:iso:std:iso:3166#SE

# These will resolve once the IG is published at https://fhir.inera.se/ig/tjanstekatalog
# NOTE: this list was carried over from the template and updated for the new
# canonical, but has not been verified against a full IG Publisher build in
# this environment (outbound access to build.fhir.org/packages.fhir.org is
# blocked here — see the PR description). Re-check this list against the
# first real CI build and add any further "fake generated link" entries for
# the new artefacts (TKOrganization, TKEndpoint, etc.) if they appear.
The link 'StructureDefinition-IneraPatient.html' for "fake generated link for Implementation Guide" cannot be resolved
The link 'Patient-IneraPatientExample.html' for "fake generated link for Implementation Guide" cannot be resolved

# The download link is absolute against the canonical URL so that it stays
# valid wherever the IG is served from. The publisher resolves canonical-
# prefixed links against the local build, where the package sits at the output
# root rather than under the canonical path, so it cannot verify this one.
# publish.yml copies output/package.tgz to the IG root on every release.
The link 'https://fhir.inera.se/ig/tjanstekatalog/package.tgz' for "Paket (tgz)" cannot be resolved

# Validator bug (not a content defect): binding-checking `Endpoint`/`Organization`
# resource-type codes against ValueSet 'Version Independent Resource Types (All)'
# throws an internal NullPointerException ("Cannot invoke String.equals(Object)
# because system is null") instead of validating, in this repo's `-tx n/a`
# (no terminology server) CI configuration. The codes themselves are correct —
# `Endpoint` and `Organization` are valid resource types — this is purely a
# validator limitation when that particular value set can't be expanded
# offline.
#
# Two earlier attempts at this entry (full-line with a "Resource/id:
# Element.path:" prefix, then a shorter but still unwrapped substring) both
# still showed "errors = 2" in a real build and "(0 uses)" under Suppressed
# Messages. Decompiling org.hl7.fhir.igtools.publisher.SuppressedMessage-
# Information in the actual publisher.jar ($SuppressedMessage.matchesInner)
# settled why: matching is against ValidationMessage.getMessage() alone —
# never the location prefix, which was the resource-qualified part of both
# earlier attempts — and a line with no leading/trailing `%` is an *exact*
# (trimmed, case-insensitive) match, not a substring match. `%text%` is
# required for contains-style matching; using that below fixed it.
# Version Independent Resource Types validator bug
%hittades inte i värdemängden 'Version Independent Resource Types (All)'%

# Logical models (TKIndexpost, TKAPISpecification, TKVardOchOmsorgstagare) get
# their `.type` set to their own canonical URL, per FHIR's own convention for
# logical models that don't map onto a concrete data type (this is standard
# FSH `Logical:` behaviour, not a mistake). That makes every element's
# generated `.path` start with that URL, which trips the eld-20 "first path
# component should be UpperCamelCase" invariant on every single element (36
# occurrences across the three logical models, snapshot + differential). The
# invariant's own text explicitly carves this out: "Logical models may be
# less concerned about this implication." Wrapped in `%...%` — see the entry
# above for how the exact/contains distinction was determined.
# eld-20 on logical model canonical-URL paths
%The first component of the path should be UpperCamelCase%

# Same root cause as the Sweden-display-name suppression above (offline
# `-tx n/a` build can't reach a terminology server to validate
# urn:iso:std:iso:3166 codes), but phrased differently by a newer IG
# Publisher version, so the display-name entry above doesn't also catch it.
# Recurs once per resource that carries `^jurisdiction`. Wrapped in `%...%`
# — see the first validator-bug entry above for why exact/unwrapped matches
# turned out to be unreliable here.
# Swedish jurisdiction CodeSystem not resolvable offline
%En definition för CodeSystem 'urn:iso:std:iso:3166' kunde inte hittas%
